name: Kubelet Verification Bypass
description: Exploit the skip_kubelet_verification configuration flag in SPIRE Agent's Kubernetes workload attestor to bypass pod identity verification, allowing any container to claim any Kubernetes pod identity
real_world_relevance: Many SPIRE deployments set skip_kubelet_verification = true during development or troubleshooting and fail to disable it in production. This weakens the attestation chain by trusting the kernel-reported PID without kubelet confirmation, enabling container identity spoofing within a Kubernetes node.

attack_flow.description: Attacker detects or enables the insecure skip_kubelet_verification flag in SPIRE Agent configuration, then exploits the weakened attestation to spoof pod identities and obtain SVIDs for arbitrary workloads
diagram: 1. Detect skip_kubelet_verification = true in SPIRE agent config (or modify it)
2. Agent trusts the pod's kernel-reported PID without kubelet verification
3. Craft a container that reports as a different pod via PID namespace manipulation
4. Request SVID from workload API using spoofed pod identity selectors
5. Receive SVID for the target workload's SPIFFE ID
6. Use stolen identity to access services as the target workload

phases.name: Configuration Audit
phases.description: Detect whether the insecure skip_kubelet_verification flag is enabled

actions.description: Read full SPIRE agent configuration to check workload attestor settings

actions.command: grep -r 'skip_kubelet' /opt/spire/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'skip_kubelet_verification not found in config'
actions.description: Search all SPIRE configuration paths for the skip_kubelet_verification flag
Search for skip_kubelet_verification on the Kubernetes node

phases.name: Configuration Tampering
phases.description: If skip_kubelet_verification is disabled, modify the config to enable it

actions.description: Enable skip_kubelet_verification by modifying agent configuration
Verify the configuration change was applied

phases.name: Agent Reload
phases.description: Signal the SPIRE agent to reload configuration with the weakened attestation

actions.command: kill -HUP $(pidof spire-agent) 2>/dev/null || echo 'Agent PID not found - may need restart'
actions.description: Send SIGHUP to SPIRE agent to trigger config reload
Verify agent is healthy after configuration reload

phases.name: Identity Spoofing Exploitation
phases.description: Exploit the weakened attestation to fetch SVIDs without proper kubelet verification

actions.description: Fetch X.509 SVID - without kubelet verification, any process matching PID selectors receives SVIDs

actions.command: /opt/spire/bin/spire-agent api fetch x509 -socketPath /opt/spire/sockets/workload_api.sock -write /tmp/ 2>&1 && openssl x509 -in /tmp/svid.0.pem -noout -text 2>/dev/null | grep -A1 'Subject Alternative Name'
actions.description: Write fetched SVID to disk and extract the SPIFFE ID from the SAN URI to confirm identity obtained

phases.name: Evidence Collection
phases.description: Document the insecure configuration for audit and remediation

actions.description: Show configuration diff to document the insecure change

actions.command: cp /opt/spire/agent/agent.conf.bak /opt/spire/agent/agent.conf 2>/dev/null && echo 'Configuration restored' || echo 'No backup to restore'

indicators_of_compromise.description: skip_kubelet_verification = true detected in SPIRE agent configuration file
SPIRE agent configuration file modified (agent.conf or agent.hcl changed)
SPIRE agent process received SIGHUP or was restarted after config modification

expected_wazuh_alerts.description: NHI-SPIRE: Kubelet verification skip detected - weakened attestation

immediate: Set skip_kubelet_verification = false in all SPIRE agent configurations
Restart SPIRE agents to apply the secure configuration
Audit all SVIDs issued while kubelet verification was disabled
Rotate SVIDs for workloads on affected nodes
long_term: Enforce skip_kubelet_verification = false via OPA/Gatekeeper admission policies on SPIRE agent ConfigMaps
Deploy File Integrity Monitoring on all SPIRE agent configuration files
Include skip_kubelet_verification checks in CI/CD pipeline validation for SPIRE configs
Use read-only filesystem mounts for SPIRE agent configuration in Kubernetes
Implement configuration drift detection that alerts on any SPIRE config changes
Document kubelet verification requirements in security runbooks and deployment standards
